meta.name: team-combat
meta.description: 编排战斗团队：协调 game-designer、gameplay-programmer、ai-programmer、technical-artist、sound-designer 和 qa-tester，端到端地设计、实现并验证战斗功能。

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 编排多角色团队，端到端实现战斗功能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你在游戏项目中需要协调多个专业角色完成战斗功能
copy.tagline_en: Orchestrate multi-role team to deliver combat features end-to-end
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to coordinate multiple specialists to build combat features in a game project

howto.what: 安装后，Claude 会像一个项目经理，自动组建包含游戏设计师、程序员、美术、音效和测试员的虚拟团队，按设计→架构→实现→集成→验证→签收的流水线，帮你端到端地完成战斗功能开发。
howto.when: 当你提供一个战斗功能的具体描述（如“设计一个格挡反击系统”）时触发。Claude 会要求你确认每个阶段的方案。

say.text: 请帮我设计并实现一个三段连击系统。
我需要一个能根据玩家距离自动切换攻击方式的AI敌人。
say.note: 会涉及游戏设计师、AI程序员和QA测试员等角色。

say.text: 为我的战斗系统添加QTE处决动画和对应的音效。
say.note: 会调用技术美术和音效设计师生成资源。

howto.what_en: Claude acts as a project manager, assembling a virtual team (game designer, programmer, artist, sound designer, QA) and orchestrating a pipeline: design → architecture → implementation → integration → validation → sign-off, to deliver a combat feature end-to-end.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you provide a description of a combat feature (e.g., "design a parry + counter system"). Claude will ask for your approval at each stage transition.

say_en.text: Design and implement a three-hit combo system for me.
say_en.note: Claude launches the pipeline, producing design docs, code, VFX, and audio.

say_en.text: I need an AI enemy that switches attack patterns based on player distance.
say_en.note: Involves game designer, AI programmer, and QA roles.

say_en.text: Add a QTE finisher animation with matching sound effects to my combat system.
say_en.note: Triggers technical artist and sound designer to create assets.
